exposure: Mothers' coping strategy (Brief Cope Inventory components: approach, avoidant, self-blame, planning, religion)
outcome: Children's neuropsychomotor development (Bayley III Scales scores)
cohort: The study included 46 women who had Zika virus infection during pregnancy and their respective children.
finding: The use of an avoidant coping strategy by mothers was associated with lower scores on the Bayley III scale for child development.
cross-section timing: Children's neuropsychomotor development was assessed at 24 months of age.
